My experience with Empower English Academy, Sakinaka, and my mentor Annete has been truly transformative.

We analyzed literary works ranging from Franz Kafka to contemporary essayists, which sharpened my language instincts and deepened my appreciation for effective communication.

The practical exposure was exceptional. Every Saturday, I observed live classroom sessions, gaining firsthand insights into teaching methodologies, classroom management, learner engagement, and effective pedagogy. These observations helped bridge the gap between theory and practice.

Another enriching component of the program was the reading and reflection of books by authors such as James Clear, Brianna Wiest, and Darius Foroux. These works encouraged self-reflection, continuous improvement, and the mindset of a lifelong learner.

Perhaps the most profound lesson was understanding the transition from trainer to mentor.

Annete ma'am is an exceptional coach, mentor, and educator.  She has a unique ability to bring out the best in her learners and inspire them to strive for excellence.

I am deeply grateful to Empower English Academy and Annete ma'am for this incredible learning journey. The program has enriched me both professionally and personally, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking to become a skilled trainer, communicator, leader, and lifelong learner.

featured_reviews.name: Alok D
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my advanced English speaking course here recently, and honestly, the overall experience was just average—especially considering the course cost over ₹15,000.

The Trainers and the staff are handling Training and photos were professional and polite, which I appreciated. The class itself went smoothly, and when one student’ accident happened , the staff helped her quickly, which was great to see.

However, the front desk staff were quite rude and unfriendly. They kept pushing us to leave a Google review, which felt forced and uncomfortable. The center itself is also quite small—just a tiny waiting area, three speaking rooms, and one room for Staff meeting . I’m not sure if they conduct written tests here.

What really irritated me was the coordinator during the training. He kept interrupting us with instructions, read super fast from a script, and made it hard to focus during the listening and reading sections.

Overall, a very okay-ish experience. The training setup was fine, but the staff attitude and environment could use a serious upgrade.
